this mod has two versions, vanilla and seasonal. (currently not compatible with SVE!)

- vanilla will only replace his main outfit. after downloading, drop it inside your mods folder.

- seasonal replaces all of his outfits with brand new ones. you will need Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by Poltergeister in order for it to work. after downloading it, drop the 'assets' folder inside [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and let it override.

this mod is also compatible with Make Marlon Real.
